purpose: Machine-readable inventory of encoded RuleSpec modules and duplicate or overlapping policy surfaces requiring triangulation.
source_route_policy: Prefer NLP/corpus extracts when they retain official citation paths and publication state is verified; otherwise use PCO/data.govt.nz bulk XML extraction via axiom-corpus, then NZ legislation CLI fallback. Comparison oracles are never canonical law.

duplicate_clusters.triangulation_method: Compare official Schedule 1 rates and thresholds against pinned oracle fixtures; official legislation prevails on mismatch.

conflicts.description: PolicyEngine NZ uses inflation-adjusted 2024/25 placeholder rates instead of current Schedule 1 rates
conflicts.official_source_decision: Official Schedule 1 of Income Tax Act 2007 prevails; oracle placeholder rates are excluded from canonical encoding

duplicate_clusters.triangulation_method: Compare regulation rates and caps plus IRD GST-inclusive rates against pinned oracle fixtures; official regulation and agency tables prevail.
